generator: OpenAI built-in image_gen, endpoint-guided full-character pose edits
scope: Front-route preview walking only. Nineteen existing poses plus seventeen authored in-betweens, including three crossing-step poses. Departure, idle, route, stride and 1.05-second period remain unchanged.
sources: candidates.json records every selected source, pair of references and generation prompt. Original image_gen PNGs are retained in source/.
finalization: The existing Swift PixelPatch and SkinPalette pipeline protects original head/face pixels. Small-arm-motion intervals retain the complete original upper body. Other intervals retain the head, ponytail and selected torso pixels. Runtime draws one intact PNG; no optical-flow warping, rescaled body parts, crossfade or runtime limb overlays.
timing: 36 equally exposed poses. The controller derives the entry/exit phase from the shared departure endpoint instead of assuming that it must always be 4.5. World movement and cycle duration are unchanged.
quality: Whole-head pixel preservation, source hashes, visit every pose at 60 Hz, maximum two consecutive samples per pose, lifecycle/native-window regression, and paired engine-render contact/APNG comparison. Visual quality remains open to user review.
